title: dsh-evolve-le run configuration
description: Versioned configuration frozen into the run manifest at PREFLIGHT (specs/06 §2, specs/07 §7). One config drives one run lineage; the stable-demo default is K=3, no sealed access, at most 15 solver trials (specs/03 §2). Credentials are never inlined: model routes reference external root-readable files (CLAUDE.md rule 8).

runId.description: Fresh per run; never reused across run directories.

profile.description: stable-demo proves stable iteration only; formal profiles arrive with later gates and their own configs.

masterSeed.description: Master seed commitment source for every RNG stream (split, scheduler-thompson, task-sampler).

modelRoutes.description: Frozen route table; route identity (including the compatible Zen/high/1M/32k route) is content-hashed into the run manifest and every gateway receipt.

proposerRoute.description: The model route id the proposal sandbox runs behind.

sealedAccess.description: stable-demo never touches sealed tasks; the field exists so a future profile must state it explicitly, not silently default.

masterSeed.description: High-entropy secret kept out of evidence; only sha256(seed||dataset||protocol) commitments are recorded.

kTarget.description: K: admitted non-baseline candidates target (specs/03 §2); stable-demo default 3.

proposalWidth.description: W_p: independent children requested per expansion; default 3.

coldStartTrials.description: q0: forced cold-start trials per admitted node; default 1.

ucbAirAlphaPerMille.description: UCB-Air exponent in per-mille (600 = 0.6); frozen for the run.

shortlistSize.description: Final development tournament size; recorded but unused by stable-demo.

maxSolverTrials.description: Hard cap on completed development agent-task trials for this profile (specs/07 §7: at most 15).

discoveryBatchSize.description: Observed tasks per discovery batch before re-checking for failures; specs/04 §4.1 stable-demo uses 6, the K=10 pilot profile (specs/04 §4.2, specs/07 §10) uses one batch of 10; a batch may never exceed the specs/04 §4.1 hard cap of 12.

provider.description: zen-compatible preserves the DeepSeek Zen-compatible Chat Completions route shape (high reasoning, 1M context, 32k output).

inputUsdMicrosPerMTok.description: Frozen price in micro-USD per million prompt tokens.

credentialFile.description: Absolute path to a mode-0600 root-readable credential file; required for zen-compatible routes, forbidden to appear anywhere else (CLAUDE.md rule 8).

baseUrl.description: OpenAI-compatible base URL (.../v1); required when this route is the proposerRoute.

model.description: Exact upstream model id, frozen into the route plan hash and every remote receipt.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature locked by the TCB proxy on every outbound request.

tasksRoot.description: Directory of materialized pinned task directories (content-verified by preflight against the dataset pin).

baselineSourceDir.description: Lineage-root candidate package the trusted builder admits.

usd.description: Total run budget in USD micros.

wallClockMinutes.description: 16h acceptance ceiling (specs/07 §1); advisory for stable-demo, hard for formal profiles.
